newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Commission wants regulation for state aid.
newsitem.headline: Commission wants regulation for state aid.

text.p: The European Commission plans to propose a legal basis for dealing with state aid which is currently covered by an array of framework rules and notices, Jonathan Faull, a director at the directorate general for competition (DGIV), said on Thursday.
"We want to put the procedural rules in a proper regulation. We plan to go to the Council under article 94," he told a conference organised by the Centre for European Policy Studies.
The draft regulation would also enable the Commission to adopt block exemptions for certain types of aid such as for research or environment protection.

The proposal would fulfil the dual aim of providing for the automatic clearance of aid schemes and related grants which do not pose any particular competition problems and to help national courts deal with local aid complaints.
This, in return, would help reduce the Commission's workload.
